text:
tess_supply: Heads-up 1 Zeta just notified a 3-week slip on the H100 tranche and proposed a dual-leg return/replacement: small air sub-batch + consolidated sea AWB for the remainder to cut brokerage. They say replacements may arrive in separate legs under the same RMA. Thoughts?

mike_ops: That delay will pinch eu-west reserved capacity. Do we have warm spares or can we reshuffle non-critical pods?

jun_sre: Warm spares: ~10 H100-eq across us-west. Cross-region move to eu-west is possible but requires customs + courier (~60-80h). We'll lose some QPS while in transit.

omar_log: Consolidating onto one AWB saves roughly 3k in brokerage and admin, but staggered legs complicate credits and serial reconciliation. Vendor AWB they quoted: AWB-ZETA-332211.

rachel_fin: Quick money check: air transfer for 4 units ~ac700, vendor expedite baseline ac8.5k. If they give a sub-batch discount, what floor do we land at?

zeta_partner_bot: Zeta Logistics: Confirmed ETA shift +21 days. Consolidation discount available: 36% off expedite if Redwood signs consolidated RMA. Sub-batch air discount 46% if prepaid within 18h. HS Code: 85423100. RMA ref: ZETA-R-3322.

tess_supply: Can Zeta do 4-by-air now and sea for rest? We can reshuffle to cover short-term. Zeta?

zeta_partner_bot: Zeta Logistics: Yes. We can commit 4 expedited units at 46% discount (prepay 18h) and consolidate remaining 24 units under AWB-ZETA-332211. Per-leg manifests will be provided upon payment or signed RMA.

jun_sre: Operational note: incoming partial legs must map to existing node tags to avoid creating duplicate nodes. I'll add a provisioning hook for remap + reconciliation. Snippet: 
```
# remap incoming serials to target node
# csv cols: serial,target_node
for row in csv_manifest:\n  remap_serial_to_node(row.serial, row.target_node)
```

omar_log: Also insist on CSV with columns: old_serial,new_serial,action,leg,and photo_url. Example: 
old_serial,new_serial,action,leg,photo_url
H100-AAA,H100-AAA,replace,air,https://...

rachel_fin: Finance threshold: emergency sign-off up to \u20ac4.5k. Calculate total for 4-unit plan after 46%: vendor \u20ac8.5k * 0.54 = \u20ac4.59k + courier ~\u20ac700 = ~\u20ac5.29k. Slightly over. Can vendor drop a bit or split the courier?

zeta_partner_bot: Zeta Logistics: We can cover 25% of courier cost if Redwood commits to consolidated AWB for the sea leg and signs the consolidated RMA by EOD. Discount hold 12h.

tess_supply: If Zeta covers 25% courier, total ~\u20ac4.47k which is within Rachel's emergency approval. Rachel, can you confirm if you'll sign?

rachel_fin: If vendor covers 25% courier and the invoice net <= \u20ac4.5k, I can sign under emergency procurement. I need written confirmation in thread and manifest no later than EOD.

jun_sre: I'll prepare the quick remap CR and add monitoring alerts for affected pods. Also need the HS/ECCN note attached to manifest to pre-clear customs.

omar_log: Action items: 1) tess_supply to confirm prepay window and lock vendor discount, 2) zeta to provide per-leg manifest + photo CSV and HS/ECCN docs, 3) jun_sre to prepare remap hook and capacity alerts, 4) rachel_fin to approve payment if vendor covers 25% courier.

tess_supply: Locking vendor 46% on 4-unit hold for 12h pending finance. Zeta, please confirm 25% courier cover here and attach HS certificate.

zeta_partner_bot: Zeta Logistics: Confirmed: we'll cover 25% of courier for the air sub-batch if consolidated AWB accepted for sea leg. HS certificate attached on signed RMA. Holding 46% sub-batch discount for 12h.

tess_supply: Great. Proceeding to payment gating. I'll post final decision after finance signs. Marking affected eu-west pods as at-risk for 3 weeks. :white_check_mark:
